The '''Parmic sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Parmic included [[Shownar/Legends|Shownar]], [[Ealor]], and [[Laramus]]. The [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Spice Terminus/Legends|Spice Terminus]] was also located in the sector. The sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Abran Balfour/Legends|Abran Balfour]].
